setting.name: deferred_reports_report_ready
setting.description: Email sent to a user when their async report is ready to download.

value.default:
Hello {{ task.user.first_name }},

Your report "{{ task.report_name }}" has been generated and is ready for download.

Download your CSV

View all your reports

This report was requested on {{ task.created|date:"Y-m-d H:i" }}.

setting.name: subject_deferred_reports_report_ready
setting.description: Subject line for the report ready email.

setting.name: deferred_reports_report_failed
setting.description: Email sent to a user when their async report has permanently failed.

value.default:
Hello {{ task.user.first_name }},

Unfortunately, your report "{{ task.report_name }}" could not be generated.

Error: {{ task.error_message }}

View your report history

Please try again or contact support if the problem persists.

setting.name: subject_deferred_reports_report_failed
setting.description: Subject line for the report failed email.
